tier.suppressed: Suppressed findings are not counted in any tier. Escalations (internet-facing, critical asset, CISA overdue) never change the tier; they appear as extra chips.

P1.name: Fix now
P1.definition: Fix now: a vulnerability already exploited in the wild (in CISA KEV or Falcon exploit status 60-90), or a Critical that Falcon ExPRT also rates Critical.

P2.name: Fix in cycle
P2.definition: Fix in the regular cycle: not P1, but Critical, or ExPRT High/Critical, or exploit code is available (exploit status 30).
